## Coverage analysis
I first generate a list of samples for which we have: a BAM file, enough coverage, and
metainformation in the `../../data/IDs/Crepido_fish_IDs_all_data_2021Dec.txt` file. Note
that some BAM files belong to samples for which we do not have metadata (17_Om05, 17_Om07,
FU37, LR16504, LR18_06, and Mo18_05). And that some samples do not have enough coverage
(listed in `../2023-05-23/VeryBad.txt`, including 17_Om05, 17_Om07, N044Cx2, N048Cma,
N048Cmb, N048Cmc, S031Cmc, and T165Cxa).

Then, I use `samtools coverage` to get mean coverage among bases covered at least once
per contig. Note that the output of `samtools coverage` is a 9-column text stream with:
chromosome name, start position, end position, number of reads, number of bases covered
at least once, percentage of covered bases, mean depth of coverage across the whole length,
mean base quality and mean mapping quality ([see this link](http://www.htslib.org/doc/samtools-coverage.html)).

```{bash coverage, eval=FALSE}
BAM=../2023-05-18/BAM
INFO=../../data/IDs/Crepido_fish_IDs_all_data_2021Dec.txt
BADSAMPLES=/nata/mar/crepidostomum/results/2023-05-23/VeryBad.txt

if [ ! -e samples.txt ]; then
   ls -1 ${BAM}/*.bam | xargs basename -s .bam | \
   grep -v -F -f $BADSAMPLES | \
   grep -f <(tail -n +2 $INFO | cut -f 3 | sed 's/\"//g') > samples.txt
fi

if [ ! -d coverage ]; then mkdir coverage; fi

for SAMPLE in $(cat samples.txt); do
   BAMFILE=${BAM}/$SAMPLE.bam
   if [ ! -e coverage/$SAMPLE.depth ]; then
      samtools coverage $BAMFILE | \
      gawk '(NR > 1){
         if ($5 > 0) {
            print $1 "\t" $7 * ($3 - $2 + 1) / $5
         } else {
            print $1 "\t0"
         }
      }' | sort -k 1,1 > coverage/$SAMPLE.depth
   fi
done
```

```{r coveragePlots, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
samples <- scan('samples.txt', what = 'character', quiet = TRUE)
DEPTH <- matrix(0, nrow = length(readLines(paste0('coverage/', samples[1], '.depth', collapse = ''))),
                ncol = length(samples))
colnames(DEPTH) <- samples
for (s in samples) {
   DEPTH[, s] <- read.table(paste0('coverage/', s, '.depth', collapse = ''))$V2
}
row.names(DEPTH) <- read.table(paste0('coverage/', s, '.depth', collapse = ''))$V1
TotalDepth <- rowSums(DEPTH)
plot(density(TotalDepth, from = -1, to = 50))
abline(v = 75, lty = 2, col = 'orange')
abline(v = 375, lty = 2, col = 'orange')
GoodContigs <- names(TotalDepth[TotalDepth >= 75 & TotalDepth <= 375])
BadContigs  <- names(TotalDepth[TotalDepth < 75 | TotalDepth > 375])
write.table(GoodContigs, file = 'GoodContigs.txt', quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
write.table(BadContigs,  file = 'BadContigs.txt',  quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
```

## ANGSD
```{bash angsd}
BAM=../2023-05-18/BAM
ASM=../../data/RefGenomes/farionis-scaffolds.fa
BADSAMPLES=/nata/mar/crepidostomum/results/2023-05-23/VeryBad.txt
## Contigs to keep 
#CTK=GoodContigs.txt

if [ ! -e ARCTIC.list ]; then
   ls -1 $BAM/*.bam | grep -E "L|S" | grep -v -F -f $BADSAMPLES | grep -v -E 'LR' > ARCTIC.list
fi

if [ ! -d Likes1 ]; then mkdir Likes1; fi
#MININD=$(( $(cat ARCTIC.list | wc -l) / 2 ))
MININD=45
  if [ ! -e Likes1/ARCTIC.beagle.gz ]; then
    angsd -bam ARCTIC.list \
          -ref $ASM \
          -out Likes1/ARCTIC \
          -only_proper_pairs 1 \
          -baq 1 \
          -setMinDepth 20 \
          -minInd $MININD \
          -GL 2 \
          -doGlf 2 \
          -doIBS 1 \
          -doCounts 1 \
          -doCov 1 \
          -makeMatrix 1 \
          -doMajorMinor 1 \
          -doMaf 1 \
          -SNP_pval 1e-6 \
          -minMapQ 30 \
          -minQ 20 \
          -minMaf 0.05 \
          -nThreads 24 \
          1> Likes1/ARCTIC.angsd.log \
          2> Likes1/ARCTIC.angsd.err
fi
```

```{bash Sites}
ASM=../../data/farionis-scaffolds.fa
if [ ! -d Likes2 ]; then mkdir Likes2; fi
if [ ! -d Sites ]; then mkdir Sites; fi

if [ ! -e Likes2/ARCTIC.beagle.gz ]; then
   if [ ! -e Sites/ARCTIC_snp.sites ]; then
      if [ ! -e Sites/ARCTIC_snp.ld ]; then
         gunzip -c Likes1/ARCTIC.mafs.gz | cut -f 1,2 | tail -n +2 > Sites/posFile.txt
         ngsLD --geno Likes1/ARCTIC.beagle.gz \
               --probs \
               --pos Sites/posFile.txt \
               --n_ind $(cat ARCTIC.list | wc -l) \
               --n_sites $(cat Sites/posFile.txt | wc -l) \
               --n_threads 24 \
               --out Sites/ARCTIC_snp.ld 1> Sites/ngsLD.ARCTIC.log 2> Sites/ngsLD.ARCTIC.err
         head -n 1 Sites/ARCTIC_snp.ld > Sites/ARCTIC_snp.ld.header
         tail -n +2 Sites/ARCTIC_snp.ld > z
         mv z Sites/ARCTIC_snp.ld
         rm Sites/posFile.txt
      fi
      prune_ngsLD.py --input Sites/ARCTIC_snp.ld \
                     --output Sites/ARCTIC_snp.sites \
                     --max_dist 100000 \
                     --min_weight 0.85
   fi
   if [ ! -e Sites/ARCTIC_snp.sites.bin ]; then
      sed -i 's/:/\t/' Sites/ARCTIC_snp.sites
      angsd sites index Sites/ARCTIC_snp.sites 2> Sites/ARCTIC_snp.sites.log
   fi
   angsd -bam ARCTIC.list \
         -ref $ASM \
         -sites Sites/ARCTIC_snp.sites \
         -out Likes2/ARCTIC \
         -only_proper_pairs 1 \
         -baq 1 \
         -setMinDepth 20 \
         -GL 2 \
         -doGlf 2 \
         -doIBS 1 \
         -doCounts 1 \
         -doCov 1 \
         -makeMatrix 1 \
         -doMajorMinor 1 \
         -doMaf 1 \
         -SNP_pval 2e-10 \
         -minMapQ 30 \
         -minQ 20 \
         -minMaf 0.05 \
         -nThreads 24 \
         1> Likes2/ARCTIC.angsd.log \
         2> Likes2/ARCTIC.angsd.err
fi
```

```{bash PopStruc}

if [ ! -d PCangsd ]; then mkdir PCangsd; fi
if [ ! -e PCangsd/ARCTIC.cov ]; then
   pcangsd --beagle Likes2/ARCTIC.beagle.gz \
           --out PCangsd/ARCTIC \
           --threads 24 \
           1> PCangsd/ARCTIC.stdout \
           2> PCangsd/ARCTIC.stderr
fi

if [ ! -d NGSadmix ]; then mkdir NGSadmix; fi
for K in 2 3 4 5; do
   if [ ! -e NGSadmix/ARCTIC.K${K}.qopt ]; then
      NGSadmix -likes Likes2/ARCTIC.beagle.gz \
               -K $K \
               -P 24 \
               -outfiles NGSadmix/ARCTIC.K${K} \
               -minMaf 0.05 \
               -maxiter 8000 \
               1> NGSadmix/ARCTIC.NGSadmix.K${K}.log \
               2> NGSadmix/ARCTIC.NGSadmix.K${K}.err
   fi
done

for K in 2 3 4 5; do
   if [ ! -e NGSadmix/ARCTIC.K${K}.eval ]; then
      evalAdmix -beagle Likes2/ARCTIC.beagle.gz \
                -fname NGSadmix/ARCTIC.K${K}.fopt.gz \
                -qname NGSadmix/ARCTIC.K${K}.qopt \
                -o NGSadmix/ARCTIC.K${K}.eval &
   fi
done
```
